sites.name: Vast
sites.summary: Human spaceflight and commercial orbital infrastructure described through cinematic engineering imagery.
sites.takeaway: Use a visually commanding technical mission to orient enterprise and institutional partners.
sites.hl: Large-scale space systems imagery introduces the platform and mission.
sites.dl: Detailed visuals help translate aerospace engineering into credible programs.

sites.name: Figure
sites.summary: Humanoid robots with motion-focused product presentations and physical design storytelling.
sites.takeaway: Demonstrate hardware design and embodied capability with expressive product footage.
sites.hl: Physical hardware is the recognizable brand centerpiece.
sites.dl: Specific robotics capabilities explain the product beyond novelty.

sites.name: Skydio
sites.summary: Autonomous drones for infrastructure inspection and enterprise operations.
sites.takeaway: Present an integrated hardware-plus-software product system with vivid application footage.
sites.hl: The product system is anchored in real operational imagery.
sites.dl: Multiple enterprise drones and software modules are organized for evaluation.

sites.name: Zipline
sites.summary: Autonomous drone delivery infrastructure and partnerships across multiple markets.
sites.takeaway: Show a physical B2B platform through service experience and system mechanics.
sites.hl: The delivery experience helps explain a sophisticated technology ecosystem.
sites.dl: Operational scenes explain how a drone delivery system works.

sites.name: Anduril
sites.summary: Autonomous hardware and software systems for complex institutional engineering buyers.
sites.takeaway: Use dramatic industrial photography to visualize hard-to-explain autonomous systems.
sites.hl: Large product imagery helps technical programs feel tangible.
sites.dl: Software and hardware are positioned as integrated engineering systems.

sites.name: Helion
sites.summary: Fusion energy development supported by scientific visuals and manufacturing documentation.
sites.takeaway: Tie visionary R&D to clear technology descriptions and real manufacturing proof.
sites.hl: An ambitious technical proposition is grounded in a distinct energy identity.
sites.dl: Real technology stages help explain a difficult scientific product.

sites.name: Form Energy
sites.summary: Industrial grid storage made understandable through real products, large-scale deployment and engineering stories.
sites.takeaway: Connect a technically new energy solution to a concrete infrastructure problem.
sites.hl: Energy storage benefit is introduced through the scale of its application.
sites.dl: Process and materials visuals help enterprise users assess feasibility.

sites.name: Commonwealth Fusion Systems
sites.summary: Magnet and fusion reactor engineering backed by large physical hardware and lab photography.
sites.takeaway: Use actual engineering systems as the main brand visual and explain scientific milestones.
sites.hl: Real prototype imagery grounds futuristic technical claims.
sites.dl: The path from scientific infrastructure to a product is made visible.

sites.name: Saronic
sites.summary: Autonomous marine engineering platform with hardware photography and technical specifications.
sites.takeaway: Make complex maritime autonomy readable through product system visuals.
sites.hl: Watercraft imagery provides immediate engineering context.
sites.dl: The product range organizes technical capability by vessel class.

sites.name: KERN Microtechnik
sites.summary: Ultra-precision machine tools with engineering product photography and detailed specification pathways.
sites.takeaway: Use machine details and material use cases to make an expert hardware offer clear.
sites.hl: Hardware visuals and engineered performance metrics frame the equipment.
sites.dl: A technical product taxonomy enables precise machine comparison.

sites.name: Prima Power
sites.summary: Industrial sheet-metal machinery and flexible manufacturing systems for plant operators.
sites.takeaway: Balance machine photography, automation scope and application-led factory examples.
sites.hl: Manufacturing line photography makes the offering immediately legible.
sites.dl: Large machinery systems are organized by production objective.

sites.name: Rösler
sites.summary: Metal surface finishing machinery and process systems, covering process, machine and materials.
sites.takeaway: Translate manufacturing systems through product and process navigation.
sites.hl: Equipment and material process examples define industrial relevance.
sites.dl: Industrial machinery is grouped by measurable surface outcomes.

sites.name: Krones
sites.summary: Production equipment, filling machines and automation solutions supported by real plant imagery.
sites.takeaway: Use end-to-end production-line narrative to clarify a large engineering product ecosystem.
sites.hl: Industrial process scale establishes manufacturer capability.
sites.dl: Machine systems align with a factory production workflow.

sites.name: Tekna
sites.summary: Aluminum, PVC and steel profile machining systems presented through machine-led visual navigation.
sites.takeaway: Display complex factory hardware with disciplined photography and industry-specific product discovery.
sites.hl: Product imagery and production needs establish an immediate buyer context.
sites.dl: A structured CNC lineup supports specification-led evaluation.

sites.name: AIXTRON
sites.summary: Semiconductor epitaxy machines and technical materials systems for complex manufacturing.
sites.takeaway: Organize high-complexity scientific equipment with technology and product families.
sites.hl: Scientific industrial photography builds authority in advanced materials.
sites.dl: Highly technical equipment becomes navigable by technology.
